video_title: REACTION: Thanasis Antetokounmpo on Giannis being traded to Miami I NBA

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo on his gratitude toward the Milwaukee Bucks organization
quotes.excerpt: I am grateful for everything from the bottom of my heart. I would never change this for nothing.
quotes.quote: It's exciting and hard at the same time. But I'm going to be honest with you, to the Wisconsin state, I am grateful for everything from the bottom of my heart. I would never change this for nothing in the world. If anybody asked me and said, 'Would you rather play for the Lakers when you came to the league?' I would have said no. I would have picked the Bucks again and again and again and again. Not only for the team, but for the people.

quotes.speaker: Tony Cartagena
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Cartagena on the cultural impact of the Antetokounmpo brothers in Milwaukee
quotes.excerpt: Your brother and his success on the basketball court changed the franchise and then that inherently changed the city.
quotes.quote: Your brother and his success on the basketball court changed the franchise and then that inherently changed the city. It just did, because I grew up in Milwaukee. I know how bad the Bradley Center was. I played at the Cousin Center. I know how bad that place was. The bars, the restaurants, the people. It became cool to go to Milwaukee Bucks games. It became cool to go out in downtown Milwaukee. An athlete, from Derek Jeter to LeBron James in Cleveland to Tom Brady in Boston, players can change how people look at teams, how generations become fans of teams.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo on his deep connection to the city of Milwaukee
quotes.excerpt: I am grateful for everything from the bottom of my heart. Everything you gave to my family.
quotes.quote: To the city of Milwaukee, the county of Milwaukee, to the Wisconsin state, I am grateful for everything from the bottom of my heart. Everything you gave to my family, to the good, but everything. And I only keep the good ones. Everybody, and I hope you do too, because this is what sports is. And when I'm in Wisconsin, and when I do the show, and this show will be talking about Wisconsin for the next how many years, the end of the show, we'll still be talking about Wisconsin sports.

quotes.speaker: Tony Cartagena
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Cartagena on the details of the Jaylen Brown trade to Philadelphia
quotes.excerpt: Jaylen Brown was traded from the Celtics to the Philadelphia 76ers. They got back Paul George.
quotes.quote: Jaylen Brown was traded from the Celtics to the Philadelphia 76ers. They got back Paul George and then they got back four picks. I think it's two first-round picks and two second-round picks or two pick swaps, however that worked out. But yeah, that's what happened. He was moved.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo on the 76ers' roster improvement after the trade
quotes.excerpt: The Sixers got better. They got a Finals MVP. He's been from the last five, he's one of them.
quotes.quote: The Sixers got better. They got a Finals MVP. He's been from the last five, he's one of them. And you're pairing him with one of the best from Tyrese Maxey to Joel Embiid. So the Sixers got better. And not only the Sixers got better, but the Sixers now are in a very good position. It's what we say, it's a turn in basketball. They got the setup, they got the setup, but did they connect? Are they going to connect? So that's the next level of, okay, they're set. I mean, I don't know who else they can get.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo on the Charlotte Hornets' culture-based team building
quotes.excerpt: What the Hornets are doing is they're building a culture team. Everybody is a threat.
quotes.quote: What the Hornets are doing is they're building a culture team. What does culture mean? It's everybody is a threat. You don't know who is a superstar. You don't have a specific pinpoint guy and everybody can score. And the ball will be, it's going to look like random basketball, but it's not random basketball. It's not. Specific movements that they're doing. And if you watch enough film, or if your basketball eye kind of connects, you understand that it's not random. This is what they do.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo on Mamukelashvili's new contract with the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: He's going back to Georgia. He's a superstar. He's going to change Georgia.
quotes.quote: He's going back to Georgia. He's a superstar. He's going to change Georgia. He's going to go out there, really, really, believe me.
